rain.name: Rain
rain.description: Existing precipitation reporting, separate from hail.

data_description.radius: Search around the saved home location (default 5 km). The legacy rain detector rounds fractional radii up to whole grid cells.
data_description.threshold: Rain is detected only above this rain rate (default 0.2 mm/h), not at the threshold; this is neither a probability nor a five-minute accumulation. Lower values include lighter rain; higher values require heavier rain.
data_description.rain_max_age_minutes: Observations older than this limit make rain values unknown, not dry weather. Default 10 minutes; range 1–60 minutes. Freshness is rechecked between polls.
data_description.rain_poll_seconds: Check for new data at this interval (default 60 seconds; range 15–300 seconds). Polling discovers five-minute source updates; it does not create new observations.

hail.name: Hail
hail.description: Radar observations, not a forecast or official warning. Defaults are provisional, not validated safety settings.

data_description.hail_radius_km: Include radar cell centers in a true circle around the current Home Assistant home location. Default 10 km; range 0.1–100 km.
data_description.hail_poh_threshold: Report hail when a cell meets or exceeds this threshold (default 80%; range 0–100%). POH estimates hail of any size at the ground in a radar cell, not the chance of a property hit or a forecast.
data_description.hail_max_age_minutes: Observations older than this limit make hail values unknown, not clear weather. Default 10 minutes; range 1–60 minutes.
data_description.hail_poll_seconds: Check for new data at this interval (default 60 seconds; range 15–300 seconds). Polling discovers five-minute source updates; it does not create new observations.

error.invalid_options: Enter finite numbers for all settings.
